briefings.title: Snap CEO: Building Snapchat and the Future of Communication | Podcast | In Good Company
briefings.tldr: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel highlights the company's shift from a privacy-centric messaging app to an augmented reality pioneer, detailing how a flat design culture, long-term hardware planning, and agentic AI are fundamentally redefining both software development and corporate management.

briefings.title: Snap’s GPU-Accelerated Secret to Processing 10 Petabytes a Day | NVIDIA AI Podcast Ep. 298
briefings.tldr: Snap achieved a 76% reduction in data processing costs by leveraging the NVIDIA cuDF plugin for Apache Spark to run 10-petabyte daily experimentation pipelines on idle inference GPUs, requiring zero changes to existing application code.

briefings.title: What comes after smartphones, with Evan Spiegel of Snap
briefings.tldr: Snap is approaching a "crucible moment" in 2026 marked by the consumer launch of Spectacles, a transition from isolating smartphone screens to human-centric AR glasses, and a business transformation where over two-thirds of new code is now written by AI.

briefings.title: Snapchat CEO: Why distribution has become the most important moat | Evan Spiegel
briefings.tldr: Evan Spiegel argues that in a landscape where software features are easily cloned, the only durable moats are distribution, hardware integration, and robust creator ecosystems.
